publicReleaseNotes:
- **See which ungrouped components move in a Sorry dry run.** Lamp names each ungrouped component that moves below the groups, marks it as changed and explains that Lamp lists groups first.
- **Lamp uses rer 0.2.126.** The pinned tool supports the local startup, owner entry and archive restore steps in RUN-LOCALLY.md. Local port inspection now stops at its deadline if the inspection process hangs.

### Upgrading from 1.11.24

Back up data and your source changes first. Update the checkout to `v1.11.25`, run `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` and run `rer deploy` with the same environment and input file. This version adds no migrations. Keep the backup and exercise a restored copy. Check sign-in, first-run setup, Settings, incident publication, maintenance notices and your intended mail configuration. Review imported Sorry templates before using them. Preserve the original deployment checkout, ownership records and account credentials for `rer signin`. Earlier installations also follow the retained upgrade notes below, including the migration introduced in 1.11.17, the mail-off instructions in 1.11.19 and keeping `INSTALLATION_KEY` with their private secrets.

### Known limits

Use the source revision that created a technical archive for the initial restore, then update the restored copy normally. Restore into an empty destination. The existing accessibility evaluation covers selected journeys and leaves some WCAG 2.2 AA criteria unevaluated.

agentUpdateInstructions: From v1.11.24, back up data and owner source, then restore and exercise a copy before adopting the update. Update the checkout to v1.11.25, run pnpm install --frozen-lockfile (the checkout pins @runeditrun/rer 0.2.126), and run rer deploy with the same environment and input file. This release adds no migrations. Preserve the original deployment checkout, ownership records and Cloudflare account credentials for guarded rer signin to the app Worker. Name a second copy with --environment and leave LAMP_RESOURCE_PREFIX unset. Preserve the intended mail configuration. The default is MAIL_PROVIDER=none. For enabled email, explicitly select the intended provider. For deliberate MAIL_PROVIDER=none, follow the 1.11.19 notes and docs/deploy.md, including removal of conflicting sender, sending credentials, relay settings, DKIM inputs and secondary mail-provider configuration. Keep the backup and check sign-in, first-run, Settings, published incidents, maintenance start, completion, cancellation and reinstatement, and mail or text delivery where configured. Review imported Sorry templates, audience, affected services and status before publishing. Earlier installations follow the retained release history, including migration 0081 and INSTALLATION_KEY custody. Preserve immutable release records, applied migration history, owner customizations, recorded Worker names and hosting inputs. After successful publication and pointer readback, R2 cleanup keeps the current and previous snapshots. A failed publication deletes nothing. Check the published status page after deployment. Restore technical archives into an empty destination using the source revision that made the archive, then update the restored copy. Run the existing verifier, release validator and affected owner workflows before adopting. Run Edit Run fleet, 2026-11-21.
